scope: First outputs from fresh public synthetic PCM in native app path; offline pinned full-precision reference conditioned on exact captured native instructions and original PCM. No user microphone, owner service change, cloud, text/TTS fallback, semantic rerolls or live promotion.

cases.name: work
cases.input: Please ask Agent to make a brief welcome plan for an imaginary neighborhood seed exchange.
cases.expected: Natural receipt only, without task echo or generated deliverable or invented completion; genuine isolated Agent is running a held provider.

cases.name: followup
cases.input: Include a station for returning empty seed envelopes in that same request.
cases.expected: Acknowledge the exact added station as a pending steer to the same running task, without claiming it was applied or task complete.

cases.name: question
cases.input: Separately, what does water turn into when it freezes?
cases.expected: Answer ice (or substantively equivalent), not a transcript/echo or invented Agent work.

reference.runtime: Private verified Transformers 5.20.2 overlay; Torch 2.9.1 CPU eager float32; exact pinned model/codec weights, no network/GPU/owner-home mounts
reference.case_inputs: Exact native generation session instructions (including qualified history) and original PCM. Follow-up conditional input retains actual previous native reply, not a separate interactive reference history.

limits: The controlled Agent does not execute work or tools; this diagnoses dialogue around real accepted/pending task receipts.
Native/reference numerical precision, engine implementation and RNG differ; no equal-token/PCM claim.
No browser playback, audibility or complete issue acceptance is established by these diagnostic runs.
Keep every first model failure and harness failure; do not rerun unchanged inputs to obtain a passing response.
